scope: XLSX typed cells and anchored image attachments
features: Package-based DOCX/XLSX detection through SDK, CLI and HTTP worker
Inline and shared strings with split rich-text bindings
Native numbers and booleans for whole-cell tags; null creates a blank styled cell
Literal formula-looking strings, Unicode, line breaks, tabs and Excel escape sequences
Independent PNG/JPEG replacement for one-cell, two-cell and absolute picture anchors
Shared package and image normalization infrastructure across DOCX and XLSX
Original formula XML/caches and worksheet geometry preserved; automatic recalculation requested

checks.productionApiSmoke: Passed DOCX/PDF levels 20 and 61 (including empty lists), DOCX level 100, and XLSX/PDF levels 1, 30 and 50

visual.method: Actual and reference XLSX converted separately by the same pinned LibreOffice container, rasterized with pdftoppm at 96 DPI, compared as decoded RGBA pixels
visual.limitations: Selected synthetic fixtures and identical converter/fonts; not a repair-free Microsoft Excel opening or general fidelity claim

knownLimits: XLSX row repetition, formula/range rewriting and formula evaluation are not implemented
Existing formula caches can be stale until a spreadsheet application recalculates; PDF conversion uses LibreOffice
No automatic date conversion or 1900/1904 epoch handling
Bound phonetic strings, formula placeholders and chart/text-shape bindings are outside this milestone
Macro-enabled, signed and strict OOXML workbooks are rejected
Real-world Excel repair checks and full OOXML schema validation remain future gates
next: XLSX row repetition with relative/absolute formula translation, dependent range updates and independently verified calculated results
